utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Cleo, I’m still planning to come in late Sunday at the community center. What repairs still need coverage?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Dane — for now we’re only covering safety fixes like railings, lighting, and leaks, but I still need to confirm the exact Sunday timing with Rosa before I assign coverage.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Got it — just let me know once Rosa confirms the Sunday timing, and I’ll cover whatever safety fixes still need help.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Hi Uli — I’m mapping the repair drive pickups now. Which homes on your block still need help, and which are already covered?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I only know they’re focusing on safety fixes, and the timing still isn’t confirmed. I haven’t got a clean list of homes yet, sorry.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Uli — that helps; I’ll mark your block as list pending and safety-fix focused for now. If you hear even one confirmed home or gap, send it my way and I’ll slot it into the map.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Nell, no date’s confirmed yet—Vik says Cleo is still checking the time and supplies. Can you ask around specifically about basic repair requests and whether Ira still needs that extra helper?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Sure, Mina—I’ll ask around about basic repair requests and whether Ira still needs an extra helper, and I’ll keep it clear that the date isn’t confirmed yet.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, Nell — that helps. Ask around and tell me if Ira still needs that extra helper or if any basic repair needs come up.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Noah, it’s this Saturday morning at Rosa’s place. I’ll send you the exact address and repair list today so you can see what you can cover.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right—Saturday morning at Rosa’s, got it. Send me the address and list when you can, and I’ll bring myself plus whatever odd tools I’ve got.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Will do — I’ll send the exact address and repair list later today, plus anything nearby that still needs covering.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Hey Tess, I’m still waiting on Rosa to confirm the exact time, so Saturday isn’t firm yet—but we’re focusing on safety supplies for railings, lighting, and leaks.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Got it — I’ll spread the word and see if anyone can spare safety supplies for the railings, lighting, and any leaks. Just keep me posted when Rosa confirms the time.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Tess — I’ll let you know as soon as Rosa confirms, and for now just tell folks we’re only collecting those safety repair supplies.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Hey Gus, what do you need from me for the repair drive? Just give me the main details and I’ll help.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Thanks, Bo — if you can send me the address, time, and repair list, I’ll get my tools together and be there to help.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Got it — send me the address, time, and repair list, and I’ll get it together.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Rey — that sounds perfect. Just check in when you arrive, and I’ll point you to whatever still needs fixing.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Okay — I’ll bring what tools I have and check with you when I get there.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Great, thank you, Rey — and if I look blank when you arrive, just remind me we’re sorting the repair drive fixes and I’ll get you pointed the right way.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Saturday late morning into early afternoon is the plan, and I’ll make sure we wrap on the early side so it works around the school schedule.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: That works for me—if we aim for late morning and wrap early afternoon, I can tell the school families Saturday is the day.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Perfect — I’ll keep it to Saturday late morning through early afternoon and start confirming the setup and volunteer list.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Rosa — I’ll hold off on any firm timing and focus on the safety supplies and space for the repairs.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Perfect, thank you, Pia — and just so we’re aligned, the repair drive is now Sunday at the community center, so safety supplies and repair space there would be wonderful.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Got it, Rosa — Sunday at the community center works, and I’ll focus on safety supplies and making sure we have enough repair space there.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Sam, the repair drive’s shaping up well — Opal’s sorting stations, Mara still needs help with table setup and a couple more repair volunteers, and I’m asking around to connect folks where they’re needed.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Thanks, Jules — I can help Mara with table setup and take a repair volunteer slot with my basic tools and spare hardware. If you point me to the time and place, I’ll be there.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: That’s perfect, Sam — I’ll let Mara know you’re in for table setup and repairs, and I’ll check with Opal for the exact time and spot so I can point you there.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Kira, I’m keeping the repair drive set for Saturday the 18th from nine to noon, and I’m just waiting on Lila’s piece before I send out the final task list.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Thanks, Eli—before I pass that along, has Hana signed off on Saturday the 18th, nine to noon, and are we still only asking for safety repair supplies right now?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I haven’t heard back from Hana yet, and yes, let’s keep it to safety repair supplies for now.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hi Hana, I’m spreading the word about the repair drive—we still need a few repair volunteers and help with table setup, so I’d love for you to come or pass the invite along.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Quinn — I’ll help pass it along, but I’m still confirming the final start time and tools list, so I’ll only share the volunteer and table setup needs for now.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect, thanks Hana — I’ll do the same and keep it to volunteers and table setup until you confirm the start time and tools list.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Sure — what details do you want me to double-check for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Could you double-check the time, location, and what kinds of repairs Kira wants covered? I’m planning to bring basic tools and spare hardware, but I want to make sure I’m filling the right gaps.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Absolutely, Sam — I’ll confirm the time, location, and Kira’s repair categories before you pack anything extra. For now I only have Saturday the 18th, nine to noon penciled in, so I’ll pass along the definite details once I’ve checked them.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Faye, I’m still waiting on the confirmed date from Cleo, but what have you heard about which repair jobs or supplies still need covering?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I haven’t heard anything firm yet either—I'm still waiting on the date and timing before I can sort it around school drop-off. Once Cleo confirms, I think we should focus on the safety repairs and whatever essential supplies are still missing.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Alright—can you check with Cleo which safety repairs are top priority and what essential supplies are still missing once the date’s confirmed?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Hi Noah — I’m quietly checking who might lend tool kits for the repair drive; it sounds like they’re focusing on safety fixes for now, and the exact weekend time isn’t settled yet.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right — thanks for the heads-up. I’m still waiting on Leo for the details, but I can bring myself and a few odd tools.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Noah — a few odd tools would help, especially if they’re keeping it to railings, lighting, and leaks. I’ll let you know when I hear the confirmed time.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Yep — we’re still keeping it to safety fixes for now, and I’ll send you the time plus a short bring list as soon as Rosa and I lock it in.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Got it — safety fixes only. I’ll wait for the time and bring list, and I’ll do my best not to forget it.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Oren — once Rosa and I finish checking the closet, I’ll send you the time and a simple list so it’s easy to remember.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Jules, I’m spreading the word about the repair drive—Mara’s helping with setup and volunteers, and we’d love for you to come or pass the invite along.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely — I’d be glad to come and I can pass the invite along too. If there’s anything else you still need for setup or volunteers, I’m happy to help.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: That’s wonderful, Jules—thank you! If you can bring one neighbor along and help share the invite, that would really boost turnout.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Dane, quick heads-up — I heard from Rosa the repair drive’s now moved to Sunday at the community center, and they could still use folding tables or tool kits if you know anyone with extras.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Tess — I’m still coming late Sunday, and I’ll bring my gloves and basic tools; I can ask around about an extra folding table too.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: That’d be perfect, Dane — I’ll pass along that you’re coming late Sunday with tools, and if you find a spare table I’ll make sure Rosa hears too.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: If you know the drop-off time, could you tell me? I’m just trying to avoid everyone piling in before the tables are ready.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Not yet—Cleo’s still confirming the time. I’ll send it over as soon as I get it so you can pace the setup.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Leo—please do, and maybe hold off telling folks to come early until we know the tables and space are actually set.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Rey — can you let me know which homes still need help and which ones are already covered? I’m mapping out the pickups now.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I don’t have the confirmed home list yet, Opal — Oren seemed to have pieces of it, and Rosa said she’s pulling it together, so I’d check with them before you map too much.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Rey — I’ll hold off on locking the pickup map and check with Oren and Rosa first so we don’t duplicate anything.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Hi Vik, I’m still piecing together the repair drive from what others have told me—have you heard any confirmed details on the date or what repairs they’ll accept?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Not yet—Cleo’s still confirming the time and what supplies we’ll need, so I don’t have the date or repair list locked yet. I’ll pass it along as soon as she confirms it.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Vik—that matches what I’ve been hearing, so I’ll hold off on sharing anything until Cleo confirms it.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Eli—I’m organizing the repair drive, and it’s now Sunday at the community center. What’s broken on your end, and when are you free to help?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Rosa—I’ve got the fence, a leaky gutter, and the broken front step on my list, and I’m free Sunday. I’d like to sort clear job assignments first, then I can confirm exactly who should bring what.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely, Eli — I’ll sort the job assignments first, then map out who should bring what. I’ll match the fence, gutter, and front step to the Sunday crew and send you a clear list soon.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Hi Kira — I’m still waiting on Rosa to confirm the exact time, so I’m only telling folks we’re collecting safety repair supplies for railings, lighting, and leaks for now.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Okay, but can you confirm it’s definitely this Saturday before I send anyone your way?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Not yet — Cleo warned me not to treat Saturday as final until Rosa confirms, so please hold off sending folks until I hear the exact time.
